Tentang.title: About the Company
Tentang.subtitle: PT Samudera Inti Medisindo plays a major role as a main pillar in the healthcare supply chain, ensuring every medical institution gets the best precision laboratory instruments and diagnostic equipment.
Tentang.profileP1: Headquartered in Cianjur, West Java, PT Samudera Inti Medisindo was established with a strong commitment to improving healthcare standards in Indonesia through the distribution of globally licensed medical and laboratory equipment.
Tentang.profileP2: We ensure that all products we distribute, including renowned brands such as Allchek, RealyTech, Yasee, and Ultracare, have official distribution licenses from the Indonesian Ministry of Health and have passed strict Quality Control.
Tentang.visionDesc: To be the leading medical and laboratory equipment distributor company in Indonesia recognized for supply chain reliability, product authenticity, and dedication to continuously improving the quality of healthcare facility services.
Tentang.mission1: Providing high-quality and certified medical instruments and laboratory reagents.
Tentang.mission2: Building long-term strategic partnerships with global principal manufacturers.
Tentang.mission3: Providing responsive technical support and after-sales service for every B2B client.
Tentang.partnersDesc: We are proud to be a reliable supplier for various healthcare institutions in Indonesia.
